name: CivicBridge offline duplicate-detection benchmark
description: Manually labelled complaint pairs used to benchmark the offline TF-IDF + Haversine duplicate detector. Each pair carries a human label ('duplicate' = same physical problem at the same place, 'distinct' = two different problems). Labels were reviewed by hand; the notes state the reasoning. Texts are synthetic.

labels.duplicate: the two complaints describe the same physical problem at the same place
labels.distinct: the two complaints describe different problems (or the same problem at demonstrably different places)

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Identical wording, identical coordinates.

subject.text: Garbage has not been collected on our street for five days and the smell is unbearable.

candidate.text: Garbage has not been collected on our street for five days and the smell is unbearable.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Second report of the same garbage pile; a trailing sentence was added.

subject.text: Garbage has not been collected on our street for five days and the smell is unbearable.

candidate.text: Garbage has not been collected on our street for five days and the smell is unbearable. Reported again by another resident.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Same pothole, English spelling drift ('pothole' vs 'pot hole') and hyphenation.

subject.text: There is a large pothole on the 3rd Cross Street and two-wheelers keep skidding.

candidate.text: There is a large pot hole on the 3rd cross street and two wheelers keep skidding.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Identical text and NO coordinates on either side: the text-only path must still catch it.

subject.text: No drinking water supply in our area for three days.

candidate.text: No drinking water supply in our area for three days.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Only one side has coordinates; the missing coordinate must not disqualify the pair.

subject.text: The street lights on our road are not working and the road is dark at night.

candidate.text: The street lights on our road are not working and it is completely dark at night.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Overflowing bin vs uncleared bin, same bus stop, same coordinates.

subject.text: The waste bin near the bus stop is overflowing and has not been cleared for a week.

candidate.text: Garbage bin near the bus stop is overflowing, not cleared for seven days.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Word insertion ('the past') only.

subject.text: Garbage has not been collected near our street for five days.

candidate.text: Garbage has not been collected near our street for the past five days.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Same street light, 'several days' vs 'many days'.

subject.text: The street light near the temple has not been working for several days.

candidate.text: Street light near the temple has not been working for many days.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Identical Tamil-script text and coordinates.

subject.text: எங்கள் தெருவில் ஐந்து நாட்களாக குப்பை அள்ளப்படவில்லை. துர்நாற்றம் பரவுகிறது.

candidate.text: எங்கள் தெருவில் ஐந்து நாட்களாக குப்பை அள்ளப்படவில்லை. துர்நாற்றம் பரவுகிறது.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Tamil script, whitespace split inside a word ('வரவில்லை' vs 'வர வில்லை').

subject.text: எங்கள் தெருவில் தண்ணீர் வரவில்லை.

candidate.text: எங்கள் தெருவில் தண்ணீர் வர வில்லை.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Tamil road pothole reported twice with punctuation variation.

subject.text: அண்ணா நகர் சாலையில் பெரிய பள்ளம் உள்ளது, விபத்து நடக்கும்.

candidate.text: அண்ணா நகர் சாலையில் பெரிய பள்ளம் உள்ளது. விபத்து நடக்கும்.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Transliterated Tamil, spelling drift ('aindhu'/'aindhu', 'allapadavillai'/'alla padavillai').

subject.text: Engal theruvil aindhu naatkalaga kuppai allapadavillai.

candidate.text: Enga theruvil aindhu naatkal kuppai alla padavillai.

pairs.label: duplicate
pairs.note: Transliterated Tamil water complaint, no coordinates, minor word ending drift.

subject.text: Kudineer viniyogam illai moonru naatkalaga.

candidate.text: Kudineer viniyogam illa moonru naatkal.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: Different categories (waste vs water) at the same place; the category guard must keep this out.

subject.text: Garbage has not been collected on our street for the past five days and it smells terrible.

candidate.text: There has been no drinking water supply on our street for the past five days.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: Classic false-positive trap: near-identical wording, but Anna Nagar and Besant Nagar bus stops are ~11 km apart.

subject.text: A large pothole has formed near the Anna Nagar bus stop.

candidate.text: A large pothole has formed near the Besant Nagar bus stop.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: Different categories (lighting vs road) and different problems at the same place.

subject.text: Street lights on our road have not been working for a week.

candidate.text: The road on our street has deep potholes and needs urgent repair.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: No coordinates; water outage vs a broken street light are unrelated problems.

subject.text: No drinking water supply in our area for three days.

candidate.text: The street lights near our house are not working.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: Same category, different lighting faults at different places (temple vs market).

subject.text: The street light pole near the temple is damaged.

candidate.text: The stretch near the market has no working lights.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: No coordinates; waste piling up vs a broken light at the same landmark are different problems.

subject.text: Waste is piling up near the school gate.

candidate.text: The street light near the school gate is broken.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: No coordinates; a shared sentence frame ('a problem in our area') hides two unrelated complaints.

subject.text: There is a water leakage problem in our area.

candidate.text: There is a garbage problem in our area.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: Identical Tamil road wording, but Anna Nagar and Besant Nagar are far apart.

subject.text: அண்ணா நகர் சாலையில் பெரிய பள்ளம் உள்ளது.

candidate.text: பெசன்ட் நகர் சாலையில் பெரிய பள்ளம் உள்ளது.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.note: Transliterated Tamil, same place but waste vs water (category guard).

subject.text: Enga theruvil kuppai allapadavillai.

candidate.text: Enga theruvil kudineer viniyogam illai.
